tasks.name: l1过滤
tasks.commands:
<<taskjs>>
( async () => { const mod = await import ( '/scripts/extensions/third-party/LittleWhiteBox/modules/story-summary/generate/prompt.js' ); const keywords = [ '肉棒' , '小穴' ]; const floors = [ 5 , 12 , 30 ];
    // ====== 修改这里 ======
    const FILTER_USER = false;  // true = 过滤用户楼层；false = 显示（默认关闭）
    // =====================

    mod. setL1FilterKeywords (keywords);
    mod. setL1BlockedFloors (floors);
    mod. setL1FilterUser (FILTER_USER); window . toastr ?. success ( `L1 过滤已写入：关键词 ${keywords.length} 条，楼层 ${floors.length} 个，用户侧 ${FILTER_USER ? '已过滤' : '显示中'}` );
})();
<</taskjs>>
